messages:
ci-bot: nightly-eval: alert: 3 suites failed for model rdx-v2-fp8 (fp8 quantized). summary: legal_cohort (blank outputs 172/500), faq_cohort (low coherence 40/500), short_prompts (truncated outputs 28/500). link: https://redwood/evals/5123456789

priya: assigning initial triage. severity: P2. I'll take legal_cohort blank outputs. @alex can you look at runtime config? :thinking_face:

alex: on it. initial hypothesis: tokenization/packing or fp8 rounding/pack kernel. will pull sample gen + raw logits. can someone paste a failing sample?

joanne: here's 1 sample from legal_cohort run:
```
Prompt: "Summarize the indemnity clause in plain english."
Response: ""
Log: generation returned 0 tokens, status=OK
```

priya: weird — generation returned OK but zero tokens. might be downstream cutoff in prefix serializer. @ops-bot please check model-serving logs for rdx-v2-fp8 around 2026-02-10T06:12Z

ops-bot: pulled logs: serving node gpu-03 reported repeated truncate warnings and max_seq==0 for requests 9a7f... see /logs/serving/gpu-03/5123456.log

alex: running local replicate: `./eval-run --suite legal_cohort --model rdx-v2-fp8 --seed 42 --limit 200 --verbose` to reproduce. sharing cmd output in thread when done.

priya: also flagging potential KV cache/serializer mismatch after fp8 compile. suggested triage steps: 1) reproduce locally 2) fetch raw logits + token ids 3) compare with rdx-v2-fp16 baseline 4) roll back routing to fp16 if urgent.

alex: quick dump: saw that sample had final token id sequence empty; logits shape (1,0). attaching snippet: ```traceback: ValueError: sequence length zero at serializer.write()``` 

joanne: can reproduce on staging with fp8 build. sending /cc to eng-runtime (@sam) and eng-ml (@maria) for visibility.

sam: FYI saw similar serializer edge-case months ago; likely bug in the new fp8 packing kernel when input length==context window. I'll look into kernel/unit test.

maria: thanks. set severity to P1 if we see >10% blank outputs across cohorts or client-facing latency spikes. For now keep P2.

priya: next actions: alex + sam to debug kernel; joanne to gather 50 failing examples and upload to s3://redwood-evals/triage/5123456789; ops to create temp routing rule to fallback to rdx-v2-fp16 for production traffic for next 2 hours.

ops-bot: created rollback route: rdx-v2-fp8 -> rdx-v2-fp16 fallback. TTL 2h. incident ticket: INC-2026-0451

priya: thanks all — will update when we have reproducer. :thumbsup:

alex: I have reproducer, opening PR with minimal test. attaching link: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/789

joanne: uploaded examples: https://s3.redwood/triage/5123456789/list.txt

priya: leaving owner to alex for root cause, joanne for sample curation. keeping sam on kernel patch. closing initial triage (keeping thread open until fix verification).

ci-bot: monitoring: eval alert auto-check scheduled in 30m.
